summary: Enhance your skills in managing cross-functional teams for oil and gas projects. Join our training course to boost collaboration and project success.
lede: Cross-functional team development for oil and gas projects gives project leaders and specialists practical ways to coordinate work across disciplines and contractors. They learn to map stakeholders and interfaces, clarify responsibilities and shared priorities, establish communication routines, manage conflict constructively, and integrate safety and risk into team decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is crafted for oil and gas professionals who regularly work across functions, projects, and stakeholder groups. It is ideal for those navigating complex project environments in upstream, midstream, and downstream operations.
audience: Project managers and project engineers in upstream
modules: Cross-Functional Teams in Oil and Gas Projects: What Really Drives Success
Mapping Stakeholders, Functions, and Interfaces Across the Value Chain
Clarifying Roles, Responsibilities, and Ways of Working
Communication Routines That Keep Cross-Functional Teams Aligned
Leading Without Authority and Influencing Across Functions
Managing Conflict and Difficult Conversations in Project Teams
Working Across Cultures, Sites, and Contractor Ecosystems
Digital Tools, Data, and Collaboration Platforms in Oil and Gas Projects
prerequisites: Participants are expected to have a foundational understanding of oil and gas project environments and experience working within or managing project teams.
